title: Rivière Classique Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
The classic, kept simple. One continuous line of round brilliant cut clear cubic zirconia of about 3.5mm, each stone held in its own gold four claw cup and linked straight into the next, with nothing to interrupt the row. A slim gold box clasp closes it. It is the tennis bracelet in its plainest and most useful form: wear it every day, or stack it with a watch.

STYLING TIP: Wear it on the same wrist as a slim watch.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Round brilliant cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 3.5mm each
  • Setting: Individual gold four claw cups linked directly to one another
  • Closure: Box clasp
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Material: Stainless steel

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
